subject: Trilogy: Trial evaluation plan & shared working doc
content:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.inference>
To: Daniel Brooks <daniel.b@trilogyhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 30 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trilogy: Trial evaluation plan & shared working doc

Hi Daniel —

Thanks again for the time today. As promised, I’m sharing a compact working template we use to run 30-day evaluations and align acceptance criteria across stakeholders. The goal here is a single living doc we can iterate against during the trial so there’s no ambiguity about next steps or what ‘success’ looks like.

What’s included in the GDoc:
- Stakeholder roster & roles (who signs off)
- Week-by-week technical milestones (env, integration, sample runs)
- Acceptance criteria (business + perf thresholds)
- Risks & blockers (and owners)
- Communication cadence & checklist for final review

Links / attachments:
- Working doc (please request access if it’s blocked): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1AbCdEFg-Trilogy-MAP-Seed
- Attached slides: trilogy-kickoff-slides-v1.pptx (2-slide kickoff brief)
- File stub: Trilogy_MAP_Template_v1.gdoc

Can you: 1) confirm who on your side should be on the stakeholder roster, 2) confirm a 60–90 minute kickoff (we typically do a 45–60 minute working session + 30 minute technical deep-dive) — suggested days: Thu 8/1 or Fri 8/2?

If you’d like, Marissa will drop in an example acceptance matrix (I’ll pre-populate with the pilot metrics we discussed) and Ben will add the infra/tech owners.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean@redwood.inference | (415) 555-0198

I can do Thu 8/1 after 11am PT or Fri 8/2 morning.

Daniel —

Thanks — great questions. Short answers below and I’ve put more detail in the working doc under the security & acceptance sections. I also added a proposed acceptance matrix so you can see how we typically convert product goals into measurable pass/fail gates.

1) PHI & safety template: we’ll add the Trilogy-specific handling notes as an appendix. Redwood’s private deployments support on-prem and VPC patterns; for hosted trials we recommend pseudonymized samples in a sandbox. I attached a short checklist to the doc for any PHI elements you expect to include.

2) Data access: for this pilot we typically spin up a private sandbox environment (dedicated instance) that accepts only pre-approved sample files. That said — if your security team prefers the evaluation run entirely inside your VPC/air-gapped infra, we can scope that under the Private deployment option (this affects timing and infra owners).

3) SOC 2 / procurement docs: please see the link I added in the doc (under Security Evidence). I’m attaching our current SOC 2 summary and will loop in security if you need the full report.

I scheduled a tentative kickoff Thu 2028-08-01 11:30am PT (45m working + 30m tech). If that looks ok we’ll lock the calendar and share the agenda. 

Action items I picked up:
- I added an initial acceptance matrix (Q1 pass thresholds + owners) 
- Sean: please confirm pricing cadence for a 30-day pilot in the MAP doc
- Ben: can you add the technical owners and signal preferred infra (dedicated sandbox vs VPC)?

Thanks — I’ll keep the doc in edit mode so we can co-author.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.inference
